in_sanskrit.name: Dadapeer
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Beloved by the Gods
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Dadapeer एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Dadapeer is derived from Sanskrit roots ‘Da’ meaning ‘God’ and ‘Pee’ meaning ‘beloved’. This name is often given to a boy who is believed to be favored by the gods and is considered a symbol of divine grace and blessings.
